verses.gurmukhi: ਓਲਾ ਬਰਖਨ ਕਰਖਨ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਬਯਾਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਬਨ ਜਰਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: olaa barakhan karakhan dhaaminee bayaar saagar lahar ban jarat agan hai ||

en.bdb: If hails be falling, lightening be making thunderous sounds, storm be raging. stormy waves be rising in the ocean and forests may be burning with fire;

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੀ ਬਿਰਾਜੀ ਭੂਕੰਪਿਕਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਲ ਬੰਦਸਾਲ ਸਾਸਨਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੈ ਮਗਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: raajee biraajee bhooka(n)pikaa a(n)tar birathaa bal ba(n)dhasaal saasanaa sa(n)kaT mai magan hai ||

en.bdb: The subjects be without their king, earthquakes be experienced, one may have been troubled by some deep innate pain and for some offence may have been lodged in the jail;

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਨਗਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aapadhaa adheen dheen dhookhanaa dharidhr chhidhr bhramat udhaas rin dhaasan nagan hai ||

en.bdb: Many tribulations may overpower him, may be distressed by false accusations, poverty may have crushed him, may be wandering for loan and caught in the slavery, may be straying aimlessly but in acute hunger;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਜਉ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਭਗਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee sirasaT ko adhirasaT jau aai laagai jag mai bhagatan ke rom na bhagan hai ||403||

en.bdb: And even if more of such worldly tribulations and distresses may befall upon Guru-loving, obedient and meditating persons dear to the True Guru, they are least troubled by them and live life ever in bloom and happiness.  (403)
